description: TATSEN crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: 8(K1 1+),C44 H60 N8 Nd4 O40 8-,14(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Nd1 (Nd) has 7 O neighbors; Nd2 (Nd) has 7 O neighbors; Nd1A (Nd) has 7 O neighbors; Nd2A (Nd) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.120-4.120 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 105.58-118.41°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula K8[Nd2{Nd(H2O)2}2(μ2-dptaO)2(μ3-dptaO)2]·14H2O (C44H88K8N8Nd4O40). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II), I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
